theorems.name: Submission.cmr_ae_zero_of_div_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (W : Set (Euclid P)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (q : Euclid P → Euclid n) (N : Set (Euclid n)) (c : ℝ), IsOpen W → μ W < ∞ → AEStronglyMeasurable f μ → (∀ x, |f x| ≤ c) → Measurable q → MeasurableSet N → (∀ (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (h : Euclid P → ℝ) (Λ : ℝ), IsFiniteMeasure ν → Integrable h ν → (∀ g : Euclid n → Euclid n, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → HasCompactSupport g → (∀ y, ‖g y‖ ≤ 1) → |∫ x, h x * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid n) (fderiv ℝ g (q x)).toLinearMap ∂ν| ≤ Λ) → ∫ x in q ⁻¹' N, h x ∂ν = 0) → (∀ b : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) b → HasCompactSupport b → tsupport b ⊆ W → ∃ Λ : ℝ, ∀ g : Euclid n → Euclid n, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → HasCompactSupport g → (∀ y, ‖g y‖ ≤ 1) → |∫ x, b x * f x * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid n) (fderiv ℝ g (q x)).toLinearMap ∂(μ.restrict W)| ≤ Λ) → ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ W → q x ∈ N → f x = 0
